items.question: Why does Paul keep speaking so late?
items.answer: Paul intends to leave the next day.

window_text.7: On the first day of the week we came together to break bread. Paul spoke to the people and, because he intended to leave the next day, kept on talking until midnight.
window_text.8: There were many lamps in the upstairs room where we were meeting.
window_text.9: Seated in a window was a young man named Eutychus, who was sinking into a deep sleep as Paul talked on and on. When he was sound asleep, he fell to the ground from the third story and was picked up dead.

items.question: Whom does Paul say is alive?

window_text.10: Paul went down, threw himself on the young man and put his arms around him. “Don’t be alarmed,” he said. “He’s alive!”
window_text.11: Then he went upstairs again and broke bread and ate. After talking until daylight, he left.
window_text.12: The people took the young man home alive and were greatly comforted.

items.original_question: Whom does Paul say is alive?

blind.question: Whom does Paul say is alive?

assessments.reason: The text says Paul threw himself on “the young man” and then said, “He’s alive!”, so the referent is the young man, matching the key.

blind.reason: Paul’s statement “He’s alive!” clearly refers to the young man mentioned immediately before.

reader.quote: Paul went down, threw himself on the young man and put his arms around him. “Don’t be alarmed,” he said. “He’s alive!”
reader.contrast: The young man is the person Paul declares alive, not Paul, who is the speaker and actor.
reader.reason: The context of Paul embracing the young man identifies the referent of “He’s,” and verse 12 confirms that the young man was taken home alive. The question tests pronoun reference and distinguishes the speaker from the person being described.

editor.quote: Paul went down, threw himself on the young man and put his arms around him. “Don’t be alarmed,” he said. “He’s alive!”
editor.contrast: The pronoun “he” refers to the young man, not to Paul, who is speaking.
editor.reason: The preceding actions center on the young man, and verse 12 confirms that the people took the young man home alive. The question clearly tests pronoun reference.
